reviews.reason: The inbox synchronously gates stored values by scope and resets stored pagination/connection/write state when authentication/client/scope changes. It installs and cleans an external notification subscription; changes can originate from auth/session replacement. Reassessed 2026-10-29: The delta follows the communications endpoint and Channel type labels; existing locale draft preservation, authorization/polling and inbox assertions remain. The delta renders complete stored title/content and structured extra as escaped React text, with nested object/array rendering. Log tests assert plain text, both locales, exact body preservation and no inferred provider fields; existing table slots remain ReactNode slots.

last stores the last successful query response for a specific identity and is updated only for defined data. It intentionally preserves visible data on fetch errors; replacing it with current query data would remove the retention contract.
